honestBoundaries.midiSemantics: MIDI carries key numbers, not enharmonic spelling or an authored visual voice order. The importer preserves the selected accepted lane's sounding keys in ascending deterministic order and does not claim to recover spelling, annotations, or complete FrankenJazz document state.
honestBoundaries.quantization: The native importer still resolves near-simultaneous note groups into bounded four-beat chart cells and skips unnameable sonorities as reported. This slice preserves exact pitches after that existing symbolic cell selection; it does not claim lossless arbitrary-performance transcription.
honestBoundaries.laneSelection: Format-1 import retains the existing deterministic aggregate/track/channel candidate scoring. Exact Manual pitches belong to the selected accepted lane; the app does not claim to merge every source track into one voicing.
